deployments_detail.use: Human-in-the-Loop AI × robotics drug discovery platform (since 2019); STING inhibitor ASP5502 to Phase I

'Human-in-the-Loop' / Mahol-A-Ba drug discovery platform integrating human expertise, AI (ML for compound design/prediction) and robotic automated synthesis; widely used in small- and medium-molecule R&D, with an AI-designed, robot-synthesized compound advancing to clinical trial. [Astellas (proprietary; robotics + ML)]
deployments_detail.value: 70% reduction in timeline to refine initial compounds into viable candidates

deployments_detail.use: Structure-based drug discovery for membrane proteins using NVIDIA Boltz-2 NIM for biomolecular structure and binding-affinity prediction, deployed as a browser-based app on the Tokyo-1 platform to let medicinal chemists run simulations independently. [NVIDIA (Boltz-2 NIM, TensorRT)]
deployments_detail.value: 90% reduction in compounds needing experimental evaluation; 70% reduction in Hit-ID timeline; full discovery cycle <1 month vs 3.5-month baseline; 2,000+ total users

deployments_detail.use: Built astABpLM (Astellas Antibody Pre-trained Language Model) using NVIDIA BioNeMo to predict antibody physical properties (stability, solubility, viscosity); incorporated into existing antibody property-prediction workflows to discover new antibodies. [NVIDIA BioNeMo (ESM-1nv backbone)]
deployments_detail.value: 50-60x speed increase for 3D structure generation (~15 seconds vs hours/days)

deployments_detail.use: Biologics research on the Tokyo-1 NVIDIA DGX supercomputer using BioNeMo biomolecular AI models (ESM-1nv, ESM-2nv, DNABERT) plus generative NIM microservices (DiffDock, GenMol, MolMIM) to generate molecular structures, predict binding and optimize efficacy. [NVIDIA (BioNeMo, Tokyo-1 DGX; Mitsui/Xeureka infrastructure)]

Strategic collaboration to deploy Evinova's AI-native clinical development platform, including the Study Designer, to design smarter patient-centered studies, eliminate rework and accelerate trial timelines. [Evinova (AstraZeneca subsidiary)]

AI-based document translation in global clinical operations, translating protocols and patient materials across 15-20 countries; cited as essential to internalizing global clinical operations and streamlining protocol development and patient outreach. [not disclosed]

Enterprise internal generative-AI platform built on self-hosted Open WebUI on Azure, letting employees create, customize and share custom GenAI models across R&D, Clinical Development, Pharmacovigilance, Compliance, Legal, Sales and Marketing. [Open WebUI on Azure; Azure OpenAI (plus Gemini, DeepSeek, Perplexity); Azure AKS]
deployments_detail.value: 3,200+ users, 800+ advanced users, 420+ custom models; 68% reported significant efficacy gains; NPS +43

deployments_detail.use: Cloud migration to Microsoft Azure (closing 6 datacenters, ~250 servers, 500 TB) with a 'Triple A' Astellas-Azure-Accenture partnership; Azure OpenAI in use for corporate workloads with Azure AI being applied to R&D insights. [Microsoft Azure (Azure OpenAI); Accenture]
deployments_detail.value: 6-month migration vs typical 2 years; ~250-300 servers migrated; 500 TB transferred
